text: dsh-token-dash 是面向 DSH Web 的 Token 看板插件，在输入框底栏、浮层和独立看板页展示会话用量。它监听 DSH 会话事件并在本地汇总输入、缓存、输出 Token、请求数和估算费用；支持按当天、近 7 天、近 30 天或全部范围查看模型明细，并设置供应商月度预算。看板还显示部分模型供应商的账户余额与订阅配额，并提供本地账本备份导入导出。需要在 DSH 凭据中配置相应供应商凭据，余额和配额查询会连接对应服务。

dsh-token-dash is a DSH Web plugin showing session token usage and estimated costs in a composer widget and dashboard. It aggregates usage locally, with model details, provider budgets, balances, and quotas. Configure provider credentials in DSH; the local ledger supports backup and restore.
想在 DSH 里看每个模型用了多少 Token、花了多少钱
Show me token usage and estimated spending by model in DSH.
dsh-token-dash 的功能「会话用量看板」：插件监听 DSH 会话事件并累计输入、缓存、输出 Token 与请求数；用户可在浮层和完整看板按时间范围查看模型明细与估算费用。
dsh-token-dash 的功能「供应商预算与配额」：看板按供应商展示月度预算使用情况以及已支持账户余额和订阅配额；在 DSH 凭据中配置相应凭据后可查询。
dsh-token-dash 使用前须知：查询供应商余额或配额时会访问 DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi、OpenRouter 等对应官方接口，凭据通过 DSH credentials 服务解析。
dsh-token-dash 使用前须知：价格估算会尝试加载 Gitee 社区价格表与 OpenRouter 模型列表；代码同时提供内置价格目录。

- 订阅模型计入 Tokens，但不计费用；计费形态按 Key 固化，不随配额接口抖动。
- 余额、配额、用量分开展示；余额失败不会把当天的 Token 记账清零。

dsh-token-dash README · 兼容与限制：- DSH `0.2.1+`；已在 `0.2.2-rc.1` 上验证。DSH 0.2.2 是预发布版，且自身要求 Node 24.9。
- 界面语言当前仅中文 / English；选择日语、德语、俄语等其他 DSH 语言时，插件文案显示英文回退。
- 升级 DSH 后插件可能从 profile 消失，重装同一个 tarball 即可，账本不会被删。
- Qwen 只统计用量，余额接口不支持；其余供应商的余额/配额以接口实际返回为准。
- 上游接口有速率限制；成功结果缓存 60s、失败结果缓存 10s，并发请求会合并。

dsh-token-dash README · 数据与隐私：- 只读本地会话 `usage`，不统计标题生成；费用与 Tokens 在本地按价格表估算，不发起计费请求。
- 余额只访问官方接口；凭据经宿主解析，不落盘、不写日志。
- 数据默认在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-token-dash/`：`daily.json`、`months/`、`prefs.json`。
- 导出 / 导入都在本地完成：导出设置 + 当月使用数据，不含配额、余额与日志；导入覆盖前会备份原文件。

dsh-token-dash README · 日志与排障：日志在 `$DSH_HOME/logs/dsh-token-dash/`，JSONL，每行带 `prefix: "[TD:<module>]"` 与 `module`：

```bash
npm run logs -- --tail 50                    # 最近 50 条
npm run logs -- --module adapter.*           # 只看供应商侦测
npm run logs -- --module provider,route      # 缓存 / 路由异常
```

常见事件：

dsh-token-dash README · 日志与排障：- `[TD:adapter.*]`：`quota.ok` / `quota.fail` / `quota.parse` / `balance.*` / `detect.fail`
- `[TD:provider]`：`probe.miss`（未配置 / 隐藏 / 失败）、`subscriptions.refreshed`、`cache.state`
- `[TD:route]`：`forbidden`（非回环请求）、`failed`
- 错误带 `errorKind`（http / timeout / network / parse）与 `httpStatus`；5xx 额外 `upstream: true`

npm run shots # 用假数据重新生成 docs/pic 的 P1/P2/P3 截图
npm run pack  # 发布 tarball 生成到 build/

dsh-token-dash README · Introduction：**Three entry points, one local ledger**: the composer-footer-right Pill shows the current model; the floating panel shows budget, balance and the usage table; the full dashboard shows every provider card and model breakdown. No duplicated accounting between pages.

dsh-token-dash README · Provider matrix：| Provider | Billing | Credential | What you get |
|---|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek | Pay-as-you-go | DS account wallet / `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | Balance, month-to-date spend, budget |
| Zhipu GLM Coding | Subscription / API | `ZHIPU_API_KEY` / `GLM_API_KEY` / `ZAI_API_KEY` | 5h + weekly windows |
| Kimi Coding | Subscription / API | `KIMI_API_KEY` / `KIMI_CODING_API_KEY`, optional `MOONSHOT_API_KEY` | 5h + weekly/monthly windows; falls back to balance |
| OpenRouter | Pay-as-you-go | `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Credits (USD) |
| Qwen | Pay-as-you-go | `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY` (CNY) / `DASHSCOPE_INTL_API_KEY` (USD) | Usage only; balance unsupported |
| OpenCode Go | Subscription | `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` | 5h / weekly / monthly windows (USD) |
| Command Code | Subscription | `COMMAND_CODE_API_KEY` + `COMMAND_CODE_ORG_ID` | 5h + weekly windows, credits (CNY) |

dsh-token-dash README · Provider matrix：- Save keys under the names above in DSH's credential settings; the plugin reads them through the host `credentials` service, not environment variables or local login files.
- Keys are detected automatically; GLM / Kimi / OpenCode Go / Command Code can be re-detected from the dashboard footer.
- Subscription models count toward Tokens but not cost; billing mode is pinned per key instead of following quota flakiness.
- Balance, quota and usage are separate; a balance failure never resets today's Token ledger to zero.

dsh-token-dash README · Interface：Screenshots use mock data so the full layout is visible at once. **P1 · Composer footer-right Pill**: pay-as-you-go / subscription variants; click to open, click outside, `×` or `Esc` to close.

dsh-token-dash README · Interface：**P3 · Full dashboard**: cards for 7 providers, summary band, 8-column model breakdown and a settings capsule; the page owns its scrollbar at the window edge.

dsh-token-dash README · Compatibility & limitations：- DSH `0.2.1+`; verified on `0.2.2-rc.1`. DSH 0.2.2 is a pre-release and itself requires Node 24.9.
- The UI currently ships Chinese / English only. Other DSH languages (Japanese, German, Russian, etc.) fall back to English.
- After a DSH upgrade the plugin may disappear from the profile; reinstall the same tarball — the ledger is not deleted.
- Qwen tracks usage only; its balance endpoint is unsupported. Other balances/quotas follow what each API returns.
- Upstream APIs are rate-limited; successful results are cached for 60s, failures for 10s, and concurrent requests are coalesced.

dsh-token-dash README · Data & privacy：- Reads only local session `usage` (title-generation overhead excluded); cost and Tokens are local estimates — no billing requests.
- Balances come from official endpoints only; credentials are resolved by the host and are never written to disk or logs.
- Data lives in `$DSH_HOME/dsh-token-dash/`: `daily.json`, `months/`, `prefs.json`.
- Export/import is local: settings + current-month usage, without quotas, balances or logs; the existing files are backed up before an import overwrites them.

dsh-token-dash README · Logs & troubleshooting：Logs live in `$DSH_HOME/logs/dsh-token-dash/` as JSONL; every line carries `prefix: "[TD:<module>]"` and `module`:

```bash
npm run logs -- --tail 50                    # recent 50 lines
npm run logs -- --module adapter.*           # provider detection only
npm run logs -- --module provider,route      # cache / routing issues
```

Common events:

dsh-token-dash README · Logs & troubleshooting：- `[TD:adapter.*]`: `quota.ok` / `quota.fail` / `quota.parse` / `balance.*` / `detect.fail`
- `[TD:provider]`: `probe.miss` (none / hidden / error), `subscriptions.refreshed`, `cache.state`
- `[TD:route]`: `forbidden` (non-loopback), `failed`
- Errors carry `errorKind` (http / timeout / network / parse) and `httpStatus`; 5xx adds `upstream: true`.

dsh-token-dash README · Development：```bash
npm test      # unit tests (80 passing)
npm run e2e   # end-to-end (temp DSH_HOME + web profile + Playwright)
npm run shots # regenerate the P1/P2/P3 screenshots in docs/pic from mock data
npm run pack  # build the release tarball into build/

Releases: pushing a `v*` tag triggers the GitHub Release (tarball) and a direct npm publish automatically (Trusted Publishing via OIDC, with provenance); see [docs/release.md](./docs/release.md) for the full checklist.

dsh-token-dash README · 兼容与限制：- DSH `0.2.1+`；已在 `0.2.2-rc.1` 上验证。DSH 0.2.2 是预发布版，且自身要求 Node 24.9。
- 界面语言当前仅中文 / English；选择日语、德语、俄语等其他 DSH 语言时，插件文案显示英文回退。
- 升级 DSH 后插件可能从 profile 消失，重装同一个 tarball 即可，账本不会被删。
- Qwen 只统计用量，余额接口不支持；其余供应商的余额/配额以接口实际返回为准。
- 上游接口有速率限制；成功结果缓存 60s、失败结果缓存 10s，并发请求会合并。

dsh-token-dash README · 数据与隐私：- 只读本地会话 `usage`，不统计标题生成；费用与 Tokens 在本地按价格表估算，不发起计费请求。
- 余额只访问官方接口；凭据经宿主解析，不落盘、不写日志。
- 数据默认在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-token-dash/`：`daily.json`、`months/`、`prefs.json`。
- 导出 / 导入都在本地完成：导出设置 + 当月使用数据，不含配额、余额与日志；导入覆盖前会备份原文件。

dsh-token-dash README · 日志与排障：日志在 `$DSH_HOME/logs/dsh-token-dash/`，JSONL，每行带 `prefix: "[TD:<module>]"` 与 `module`：

```bash
npm run logs -- --tail 50                    # 最近 50 条
npm run logs -- --module adapter.*           # 只看供应商侦测
npm run logs -- --module provider,route      # 缓存 / 路由异常
```

常见事件：

dsh-token-dash README · 日志与排障：- `[TD:adapter.*]`：`quota.ok` / `quota.fail` / `quota.parse` / `balance.*` / `detect.fail`
- `[TD:provider]`：`probe.miss`（未配置 / 隐藏 / 失败）、`subscriptions.refreshed`、`cache.state`
- `[TD:route]`：`forbidden`（非回环请求）、`failed`
- 错误带 `errorKind`（http / timeout / network / parse）与 `httpStatus`；5xx 额外 `upstream: true`

dsh-token-dash README · Provider matrix：- Save keys under the names above in DSH's credential settings; the plugin reads them through the host `credentials` service, not environment variables or local login files.

- Subscription models count toward Tokens but not cost; billing mode is pinned per key instead of following quota flakiness.
- Balance, quota and usage are separate; a balance failure never resets today's Token ledger to zero.

dsh-token-dash README · Compatibility & limitations：- DSH `0.2.1+`; verified on `0.2.2-rc.1`. DSH 0.2.2 is a pre-release and itself requires Node 24.9.
- The UI currently ships Chinese / English only. Other DSH languages (Japanese, German, Russian, etc.) fall back to English.
- After a DSH upgrade the plugin may disappear from the profile; reinstall the same tarball — the ledger is not deleted.
- Qwen tracks usage only; its balance endpoint is unsupported. Other balances/quotas follow what each API returns.
- Upstream APIs are rate-limited; successful results are cached for 60s, failures for 10s, and concurrent requests are coalesced.

dsh-token-dash README · Data & privacy：- Reads only local session `usage` (title-generation overhead excluded); cost and Tokens are local estimates — no billing requests.
- Balances come from official endpoints only; credentials are resolved by the host and are never written to disk or logs.
- Data lives in `$DSH_HOME/dsh-token-dash/`: `daily.json`, `months/`, `prefs.json`.
- Export/import is local: settings + current-month usage, without quotas, balances or logs; the existing files are backed up before an import overwrites them.

dsh-token-dash README · Logs & troubleshooting：Logs live in `$DSH_HOME/logs/dsh-token-dash/` as JSONL; every line carries `prefix: "[TD:<module>]"` and `module`:

```bash
npm run logs -- --tail 50                    # recent 50 lines
npm run logs -- --module adapter.*           # provider detection only
npm run logs -- --module provider,route      # cache / routing issues
```

Common events:

dsh-token-dash README · Logs & troubleshooting：- `[TD:adapter.*]`: `quota.ok` / `quota.fail` / `quota.parse` / `balance.*` / `detect.fail`
- `[TD:provider]`: `probe.miss` (none / hidden / error), `subscriptions.refreshed`, `cache.state`
- `[TD:route]`: `forbidden` (non-loopback), `failed`
- Errors carry `errorKind` (http / timeout / network / parse) and `httpStatus`; 5xx adds `upstream: true`.

dsh-token-dash README · Development：```bash
npm test      # unit tests (80 passing)
npm run e2e   # end-to-end (temp DSH_HOME + web profile + Playwright)
npm run shots # regenerate the P1/P2/P3 screenshots in docs/pic from mock data
npm run pack  # build the release tarball into build/

Releases: pushing a `v*` tag triggers the GitHub Release (tarball) and a direct npm publish automatically (Trusted Publishing via OIDC, with provenance); see [docs/release.md](./docs/release.md) for the full checklist.
